General Remarks.

The land sold during the year amounted to 33,840.33 acres, which realized $56,980.96. The quantity of surrendered
land in the hands of the department was, approximately, 275,482.50 acres. The principal outstanding, on account of
Indian lands sold, amounted to $376,759.47, a considerable portion of which has not yet become due.
